title: TodayWeather home-screen widgets
scenario: Samsung Galaxy S21+ • Android 15 / One UI • Korean labels • Sample weather

steps.title: Add a widget to the home screen
steps.instruction: Open the Widgets menu on the home screen, find TodayWeather, choose a widget and confirm the addition. The confirmation shown here is from Samsung One UI.
steps.caption: The launcher previews the default Classic Black clock and weather widget.
steps.expected: You can add several widgets and give each one a different place.

steps.title: Choose the refresh mode and place
steps.instruction: In widget settings, choose a style and place. Select automatic updates (once hourly) or manual updates for this widget, then scroll down and tap 저장 (Save).
steps.caption: The Blue Hour clock has manual updates selected. The other widgets keep their own settings.
steps.expected: New and existing widgets use automatic updates until you choose manual updates.

steps.title: Read a wide forecast
steps.instruction: Check the update time at the upper right. Read the current temperature above the forecast. In each daily column the high is above the low.
steps.caption: Five days of sample Seoul weather in Classic Black.
steps.expected: Drag a resize handle to change the number of columns. A taller widget enlarges forecast text and icons. The shortest one-row layout keeps compact labels.

steps.title: Check current conditions
steps.instruction: Add 현재 날씨 for an at-a-glance reading. The large number is the current temperature. The smaller pair is the daily range. Select 어제 기온과 비교 in settings to compare against yesterday.
steps.caption: Morning Paper groups the current temperature and legacy weather artwork on a yellow panel.
steps.expected: Current conditions, their location and their update time are visible together.

steps.title: Show time with the weather
steps.instruction: Add 시계와 날씨. Choose hourly or daily in widget settings. Enlarge the widget to show more forecast details.
steps.caption: Morning Paper on the Galaxy S21+. In Blue Hour, the live clock and date align on the right.
steps.expected: Time remains visible alongside the selected place and available forecast.

steps.title: Read the selected city’s local clock
steps.instruction: Set two clock widgets to different cities. Each date changes at midnight in that city. The clock follows your phone’s 12/24-hour setting.
steps.caption: On the same Galaxy S21+, Seoul shows 11:20 a.m. on November 20 while New York shows 9:20 p.m. on November 19.
steps.expected: The clock runs offline and follows local daylight-saving changes. An older overseas reading can show a dash until the next weather update supplies its time zone. The weather update stamp uses the phone’s time zone.

steps.title: Refresh a widget manually
steps.instruction: Tap the refresh control beside the last update time. Tap elsewhere on the widget to open its place in TodayWeather.
steps.caption: The Blue Hour clock shows the refresh control in its upper-right corner.
steps.expected: Widgets sharing this place reuse its reading. Within one hour of a widget request, another tap keeps the cached weather. A failed refresh also keeps the previous reading.

steps.title: Read local air quality
steps.instruction: Add 대기질 and select a place. Read the grade and AQI first, then the pollutant values and their units.
steps.caption: The narrow Blue Hour widget shows the AQI, grade face and particulate concentrations.
steps.expected: Increasing the widget size makes more of the available air-quality details visible.

steps.title: Resume after five days
steps.instruction: If five days have passed since you last opened TodayWeather, tap the message in the widget to check the weather in the main app.
steps.caption: The weather display is replaced by an invitation to open the app. Android may defer its scheduled update while the device sleeps.
steps.expected: Opening the main app starts a new 120-hour period. Neither widget settings nor the refresh button extends that period.

steps.title: Return to the home screen
steps.instruction: Open the main app, then return to the widget. The selected style and location are retained as weather display resumes.
steps.caption: The clock and hourly forecast return after reopening TodayWeather.
steps.expected: You can continue using your selected places and forecast mode without adding the widgets again.
